summary_bullets: Redirected all background Codex spawns in run-external-agent.sh from /dev/null so parent-shell stdin closure cannot break long-running Codex voters or reviewers.
Added a code-voter .done sentinel barrier before status size checks, with captured TIMEOUT logging and set -e-safe wait handling.
Populated successful empty Codex and Cursor review sidecars with informational ok markers and documented the new contracts.
Expanded offline regression coverage for Codex stdin handling, voter wait-barrier behavior, and sidecar status markers.
commit_message:
Fix three voter failure modes: Codex stdin, vote race, Cursor sidecar visibility

Redirect Codex background stdin from /dev/null, wait for voter sentinels before status size checks, and mark successful empty sidecars. Extend the offline harnesses and docs for the new contracts.
